items.title: Charlie Hardy Interview, 1961-12-16
items.q: I heard of him. I didn't know him personally.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. We used to go down there and, uh, work some kind of a riffle to get into some of those cafes, and we were, not yet old enough, to really be permitted to go, to get into the place. But by hook or crook, we got in there to listen to some of those fellows, and, uh, it added to our knowledge, and our endeavor to emulate, if you know what I mean.
Sure, sure. Well, there were some string players who, uh, later became a prominent. Did you know Johnny Fincere in those years?
I heard of him. I didn't know him personally.
